named-native-query.name: Category.search
named-native-query.query: SELECT c.* FROM TB_CATEGORIES c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_by IS NULL AND c.search_vector @@ to_tsquery('portuguese', :query) ORDER BY ts_rank(c.search_vector, to_tsquery('portuguese', :query)) DESC

named-native-query.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CATEGORIES c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_by IS NULL AND c.search_vector @@ to_tsquery('portuguese', :query)
